ROW.COLUMN: Institutions rely on and trust their employees to responsibly handle customer information and accounts. However, employee attempts to launder funds or perpetrate fraud sometimes occurs and poses a liability to the institution. This scenario detects journals between accounts either owned by, or related to, employees of the firm and one or more unrelated accounts, or detects journals that are entered by the employee. This could indicate an employee's attempt to move funds from customer accounts for the purposes of fraud, or to launder funds through multiple accounts to avoid calling attention to the activity.

d_Trxn_Base_Am, CASE WHEN BOT.TRSTD_TRXN_FL = 'Y' THEN BOT.TRXN_BASE_AM ELSE 0 END AS d_Trusted_Trans_Amt, CASE WHEN BOT.BO_TRXN_ACTVY_RISK_NB > @Actvty_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl THEN BOT.TRXN_BASE_AM ELSE 0 END AS d_Hr_Trxn_Am, CASE WHEN BOT.TRXN_BASE_AM - TRUNC(BOT.TRXN_BASE_AM, -@Lrf_Digits) = 0 THEN BOT.TRXN_BASE_AM WHEN BOT.TRXN_RPTNG_AM - TRUNC(BOT.TRXN_RPTNG_AM, -@Lrf_Digits) = 0 THEN BOT.TRXN_BASE_AM ELSE 0 END AS d_Lrf_Trxn_Am FROM --Acct @BUSINESS@.ACCT A, --Employee @BUSINESS@.EMP E, --Employee or Employee Related Accounts @BUSINESS@.NTWK_USER_ACCT_MAP NUAM, --Include Back Office Transactions only @BUSINESS@.BACK_OFFICE_TRXN BOT WHERE A.ACCT_INTRL_ID = NUAM.ACCT_INTRL_ID AND NUAM.EMP_INTRL_ID = E.EMP_INTRL_ID AND A.ACCT_INTRL_ID = BOT.ACCT_INTRL_ID --unrelated account AND BOT.UNRLTD_PARTY_CD IS NOT NULL --Exclude Test Accounts AND NVL(A.TEST_ACCT_FL,'N') <> 'Y' --Exclude Exempt Accounts AND A.ACCT_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 --Exclude Canceled and Canceling Back Office Journal Transactions AND BOT.CXL_PAIR_TRXN_INTRL_ID IS NULL --Exclude Distribution, Dividend, Fee, Interest, and Transfer-of-Account Transactions AND BOT.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD = 'GENERAL' --Include Back Office Journal Transactions only AND BOT.MANTAS_TRXN_PRDCT_CD = 'JOURNAL' --Lookback Period AND BOT.EXCTN_DT <= (SELECT MAX(KC.CLNDR_DT) FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC WHERE KC.CLNDR_NM=@Calendar_Name AND KC.BUS_DAY_AGE=0 AND KC.BUS_DAY_FL = 'Y') AND BOT.EXCTN_DT >= (SELECT MIN(KC.CLNDR_DT) FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC WHERE KC.CLNDR_NM=@Calendar_Name AND KC.BUS_DAY_AGE=@Look_Back_Period-1 AND KC.BUS_DAY_FL = 'Y') AND BOT.DATA_DUMP_DT <= (SELECT MAX(KC.CLNDR_DT) FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC WHERE KC.CLNDR_NM=@Calendar_Name AND KC.BUS_DAY_AGE=0 AND KC.BUS_DAY_FL = 'Y') AND BOT.DATA_DUMP_DT >= (SELECT MIN(KC.CLNDR_DT) FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC WHERE KC.CLNDR_NM=@Calendar_Name AND KC.BUS_DAY_AGE=@Look_Back_Period-1 AND KC.BUS_DAY_FL = 'Y') --To Include Oracle Business Acct Types AND A.MANTAS_ACCT_BUS_TYPE_CD IN (@Mantas_Bus_Acct_Type_Lst) --Jurisdiction filter AND ((@All_Jurisdictions_Fl = 'Y') OR (E.JRSDCN_CD IN (@Incl_Jurisdictions_Lst))) --Include Trusted Transactions AND (@Incl_Trusted_Trxn_Fl = 'Y' or COALESCE(BOT.TRSTD_TRXN_FL,'N') ='N') ), main_qry2 AS ( SELECT t.d_Emp_Intrl_Id, t.EMP_SEQ_ID, d_Emp_Hire_Dt, CASE WHEN SUM(t.d_Trxn_Base_Am) > 0 THEN (SUM(t.d_Lrf_Trxn_Am)/SUM(t.d_Trxn_Base_Am))*100 ELSE 0 END AS d_Lrf_Prctg,
CASE WHEN SUM(t.d_Trxn_Base_Am) > 0 THEN (SUM(t.d_Hr_Trxn_Am)/SUM(t.d_Trxn_Base_Am))*100 ELSE 0 END AS d_Hr_Prctg,
CASE WHEN SUM(t.d_Trxn_Base_Am) > 0 THEN (SUM(t.d_Trusted_Trans_Amt)/SUM(t.d_Trxn_Base_Am))*100 ELSE 0 END AS d_Trusted_Trans_Prctg,
MAX(t.d_Efctv_Risk_Nb) d_Efctv_Risk_Nb, MAX(t.d_Actvy_Risk_Nb) d_Actvy_Risk_Nb, MAX(t.d_Data_Dump_Dt) d_Data_Dump_Dt, SUM(t.d_Trxn_Base_Am) d_Trans_Amt, COUNT(t.d_Trxn_Base_Am) d_Trans_Ct, COUNT(DISTINCT(t.d_Empl_Acct_Ct)) d_Empl_Acct_Ct, COUNT(DISTINCT(t.d_Offset_Acct_Ct)) d_Offset_Acct_Ct, CASE WHEN MAX(t.d_Efctv_Risk_Nb) >= @Effctv_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl AND MAX(t.d_Actvy_Risk_Nb) >= @Actvty_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl THEN 'HR' WHEN MAX(t.d_Efctv_Risk_Nb) < @Effctv_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl AND MAX(t.d_Actvy_Risk_Nb) < @Actvty_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl THEN 'RR' ELSE 'MR' END d_Overall_Risk, CASE WHEN ((SELECT MAX(KC.CLNDR_DT) FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC WHERE KC.CLNDR_NM=@Calendar_Name AND KC.BUS_DAY_AGE=0 AND KC.BUS_DAY_FL = 'Y') - d_Emp_Hire_Dt) >= @Min_Employment_Length THEN 'SEASONED' WHEN ((SELECT MAX(KC.CLNDR_DT) FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC WHERE KC.CLNDR_NM=@Calendar_Name AND KC.BUS_DAY_AGE=0 AND KC.BUS_DAY_FL = 'Y') - d_Emp_Hire_Dt) < @Min_Employment_Length THEN 'NEW' END d_emp_type FROM main_qry1 t, (SELECT MIN(CLNDR_DT) MIN_CLNDR_DT FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL WHERE BUS_DAY_AGE = @Frequency_Period-1 AND CLNDR_NM = @Calendar_Name AND BUS_DAY_FL = 'Y') k1, (SELECT MAX(CLNDR_DT) MAX_CLNDR_DT FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL WHERE BUS_DAY_AGE = 0 AND CLNDR_NM = @Calendar_Name AND BUS_DAY_FL = 'Y') k2 GROUP BY t.d_Emp_Intrl_Id, t.EMP_SEQ_ID, d_Emp_Hire_Dt HAVING (MAX(T.D_DATA_DUMP_DT) BETWEEN MAX(K1.MIN_CLNDR_DT) AND MAX(K2.MAX_CLNDR_DT)) ) SELECT P.d_Emp_Intrl_Id, P.EMP_SEQ_ID, P.d_Lrf_Prctg, P.d_Hr_Prctg, P.d_Trusted_Trans_Prctg, --Effctv Risk Lvl P.d_Efctv_Risk_Nb, --Actvty Risk Lvl P.d_Actvy_Risk_Nb, --Tot Journal Amt P.d_Trans_Amt, --Tot Journal Ct P.d_Trans_Ct, --Overall Risk P.d_Overall_Risk, --Empl Acct Ct P.d_Empl_Acct_Ct, --Offset Acct Ct P.d_Offset_Acct_Ct, --Employee Type New or Seasoned P.d_emp_type, --Current Date (SELECT MAX(KC.CLNDR_DT) FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC WHERE KC.CLNDR_NM=@Calendar_Name AND KC.BUS_DAY_AGE=0 AND KC.BUS_DAY_FL = 'Y') d_Current_Dt FROM main_qry2 P

--Back Office Transaction BB Employee Journals SELECT NUAM.EMP_INTRL_ID, BOT.BO_TRXN_SEQ_ID FROM --Acct @BUSINESS@.ACCT A, --Employee or Employee Related Accounts @BUSINESS@.NTWK_USER_ACCT_MAP NUAM, --Include Back Office Transactions only @BUSINESS@.BACK_OFFICE_TRXN BOT WHERE NUAM.ACCT_INTRL_ID = A.ACCT_INTRL_ID AND A.ACCT_INTRL_ID = BOT.ACCT_INTRL_ID --unrelated account AND BOT.UNRLTD_PARTY_CD is NOT NULL --Exclude Test Accounts AND NVL(A.TEST_ACCT_FL,'N') <> 'Y' --Exclude Exempt Accounts AND A.ACCT_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 --Exclude Canceled and Canceling Back Office Journal Transactions AND BOT.CXL_PAIR_TRXN_INTRL_ID is NULL --Exclude Distribution, Dividend, Fee, Interest, and Transfer-of-Account Transactions AND BOT.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD = 'GENERAL' --Include Back Office Journal Transactions only AND BOT.MANTAS_TRXN_PRDCT_CD = 'JOURNAL' --Lookback Period AND BOT.EXCTN_DT <= (SELECT MAX(KC.CLNDR_DT) FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC WHERE KC.CLNDR_NM=@Calendar_Name AND KC.BUS_DAY_AGE=0 AND KC.BUS_DAY_FL = 'Y') AND BOT.EXCTN_DT >= (SELECT MIN(KC.CLNDR_DT) FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC WHERE KC.CLNDR_NM=@Calendar_Name AND KC.BUS_DAY_AGE=@Look_Back_Period-1 AND KC.BUS_DAY_FL = 'Y') AND BOT.DATA_DUMP_DT <= (SELECT MAX(KC.CLNDR_DT) FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC WHERE KC.CLNDR_NM=@Calendar_Name AND KC.BUS_DAY_AGE=0 AND KC.BUS_DAY_FL = 'Y') AND BOT.DATA_DUMP_DT >= (SELECT MIN(KC.CLNDR_DT) FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC WHERE KC.CLNDR_NM=@Calendar_Name AND KC.BUS_DAY_AGE=@Look_Back_Period-1 AND KC.BUS_DAY_FL = 'Y') --To Include Oracle Business Acct Types AND A.MANTAS_ACCT_BUS_TYPE_CD in (@Mantas_Bus_Acct_Type_Lst) --Include Trusted Transactions AND (@Incl_Trusted_Trxn_Fl = 'Y' or COALESCE(BOT.TRSTD_TRXN_FL,'N') ='N')

--Account BB Employee Journals SELECT DISTINCT A.ACCT_SEQ_ID, NUAM.EMP_INTRL_ID FROM --Acct @BUSINESS@.ACCT A, --Employee or Employee Related Accounts @BUSINESS@.NTWK_USER_ACCT_MAP NUAM, --Include Back Office Transactions only @BUSINESS@.BACK_OFFICE_TRXN BOT WHERE NUAM.ACCT_INTRL_ID = A.ACCT_INTRL_ID AND A.ACCT_INTRL_ID = BOT.ACCT_INTRL_ID --unrelated account AND BOT.UNRLTD_PARTY_CD is NOT NULL --Exclude Test Accounts AND NVL(A.TEST_ACCT_FL,'N') <> 'Y' --Exclude Exempt Accounts AND A.ACCT_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 --Exclude Canceled and Canceling Back Office Journal Transactions AND BOT.CXL_PAIR_TRXN_INTRL_ID is NULL --Exclude Distribution, Dividend, Fee, Interest, and Transfer-of-Account Transactions AND BOT.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD = 'GENERAL' --Include Back Office Journal Transactions only AND BOT.MANTAS_TRXN_PRDCT_CD = 'JOURNAL' --Lookback Period AND BOT.EXCTN_DT <= (SELECT MAX(KC.CLNDR_DT) FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC WHERE KC.CLNDR_NM=@Calendar_Name AND KC.BUS_DAY_AGE=0 AND KC.BUS_DAY_FL = 'Y') AND BOT.EXCTN_DT >= (SELECT MIN(KC.CLNDR_DT) FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC WHERE KC.CLNDR_NM=@Calendar_Name AND KC.BUS_DAY_AGE=@Look_Back_Period-1 AND KC.BUS_DAY_FL = 'Y') AND BOT.DATA_DUMP_DT <= (SELECT MAX(KC.CLNDR_DT) FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC WHERE KC.CLNDR_NM=@Calendar_Name AND KC.BUS_DAY_AGE=0 AND KC.BUS_DAY_FL = 'Y') AND BOT.DATA_DUMP_DT >= (SELECT MIN(KC.CLNDR_DT) FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC WHERE KC.CLNDR_NM=@Calendar_Name AND KC.BUS_DAY_AGE=@Look_Back_Period-1 AND KC.BUS_DAY_FL = 'Y') --To Include Oracle Business Acct Types AND A.MANTAS_ACCT_BUS_TYPE_CD in (@Mantas_Bus_Acct_Type_Lst) --Include Trusted Transactions AND (@Incl_Trusted_Trxn_Fl = 'Y' or COALESCE(BOT.TRSTD_TRXN_FL,'N') ='N')

--Primary Rule Employee Journals - Employee Entered (EENT) Pattern with All_Trxn as (SELECT DISTINCT E.EMP_INTRL_ID, E.EMP_SEQ_ID, E.EMP_HIRE_DT, BOT.DATA_DUMP_DT, A.ACCT_EFCTV_RISK_NB as Efctv_Risk_Nb, BOT.BO_TRXN_ACTVY_RISK_NB as Actvy_Risk_Nb, BOT.BO_TRXN_SEQ_ID, BOT.ACCT_INTRL_ID, BOT.OFFST_ACCT_INTRL_ID, CASE WHEN BOT.OFFST_ACCT_INTRL_ID in (select NUAM.ACCT_INTRL_ID from @BUSINESS@.NTWK_USER_ACCT_MAP NUAM where E.EMP_INTRL_ID = NUAM.EMP_INTRL_ID and BOT.OFFST_ACCT_INTRL_ID = NUAM.ACCT_INTRL_ID) THEN BOT.OFFST_ACCT_INTRL_ID ELSE null END AS Emp_Offst_Acct, BOT.TRXN_BASE_AM, CASE WHEN BOT.TRSTD_TRXN_FL = 'Y' THEN BOT.TRXN_BASE_AM ELSE 0 END AS Trusted_Trans_Amt, CASE WHEN BOT.BO_TRXN_ACTVY_RISK_NB > @Actvty_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl THEN BOT.TRXN_BASE_AM ELSE 0 END AS Hr_Trxn_Am, CASE WHEN BOT.TRXN_BASE_AM - TRUNC(BOT.TRXN_BASE_AM, -@Lrf_Digits) = 0 THEN BOT.TRXN_BASE_AM WHEN BOT.TRXN_RPTNG_AM - TRUNC(BOT.TRXN_RPTNG_AM, -@Lrf_Digits) = 0 THEN BOT.TRXN_BASE_AM ELSE 0 END AS Lrf_Trxn_Am, CASE WHEN E.EMP_HIRE_DT is not null AND ((SELECT KC.CLNDR_DT FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC WHERE KC.CLNDR_NM=@Calendar_Name AND KC.BUS_DAY_AGE = 0 AND KC.BUS_DAY_FL = 'Y') - E.EMP_HIRE_DT) < @Min_Employment_Length THEN 'NEW' ELSE 'SEASONED' END AS Emp_Type
FROM --Employee @BUSINESS@.EMP E -- Back Office Transactions INNER JOIN @BUSINESS@.BACK_OFFICE_TRXN BOT ON BOT.TRXN_ENTRY_USER_INTRL_ID = E.EMP_INTRL_ID -- Account INNER JOIN @BUSINESS@.ACCT A ON A.ACCT_INTRL_ID = BOT.ACCT_INTRL_ID WHERE BOT.DBT_CDT_CD = 'C' --Exclude Canceled and Canceling Back Office Journal Transactions AND BOT.CXL_PAIR_TRXN_INTRL_ID IS NULL --Include Back Office Journal Transactions only AND BOT.MANTAS_TRXN_PRDCT_CD = 'JOURNAL' --Exclude Distribution, Dividend, Fee, Interest, and Transfer-of-Account Transactions AND BOT.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD = 'GENERAL' --Exclude Exempt Accounts AND A.ACCT_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 --Exclude Test Accounts AND COALESCE(A.TEST_ACCT_FL,'N') <> 'Y' --employee account, an account related to another employee, or a customer account AND A.MANTAS_ACCT_HOLDR_TYPE_CD in ('CR','CI','EE','IA') --Oracle Business Acct Types AND A.MANTAS_ACCT_BUS_TYPE_CD IN (@Mantas_Bus_Acct_Type_Lst) --Included Jurisdiction Codes AND (@All_Jurisdictions_Fl = 'Y' OR E.JRSDCN_CD IN (@Incl_Jurisdictions_Lst)) --Include Trusted Transactions AND (@Incl_Trusted_Trxn_Fl = 'Y' or COALESCE(BOT.TRSTD_TRXN_FL,'N') ='N') --Lookback Period AND BOT.EXCTN_DT IN (SELECT KC.CLNDR_DT FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC WHERE KC.CLNDR_NM = @Calendar_Name AND KC.BUS_DAY_FL = 'Y' AND KC.BUS_DAY_AGE between 0 and @Look_Back_Period - 1) AND BOT.DATA_DUMP_DT IN (SELECT KC.CLNDR_DT FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC WHERE KC.CLNDR_NM = @Calendar_Name AND KC.BUS_DAY_FL = 'Y' AND KC.BUS_DAY_AGE between 0 and @Look_Back_Period - 1) --An account unrelated to an employee AND NOT EXISTS (select 1 from @BUSINESS@.NTWK_USER_ACCT_MAP NUAM where E.EMP_INTRL_ID = NUAM.EMP_INTRL_ID and A.ACCT_INTRL_ID = NUAM.ACCT_INTRL_ID) --Frequency Period AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @BUSINESS@.BACK_OFFICE_TRXN B WHERE B.TRXN_ENTRY_USER_INTRL_ID = E.EMP_INTRL_ID AND B.ACCT_INTRL_ID = A.ACCT_INTRL_ID --Frequency Period AND B.DATA_DUMP_DT IN (SELECT KC.CLNDR_DT FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC WHERE KC.CLNDR_NM=@Calendar_Name AND KC.BUS_DAY_FL = 'Y' AND KC.BUS_DAY_AGE between 0 and @Frequency_Period - 1) AND B.DBT_CDT_CD = 'C' --Exclude Canceled and Canceling Back Office Journal Transactions AND B.CXL_PAIR_TRXN_INTRL_ID IS NULL --Include Back Office Journal Transactions only AND B.MANTAS_TRXN_PRDCT_CD = 'JOURNAL' --Exclude Distribution, Dividend, Fee, Interest, and Transfer-of-Account Transactions AND B.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD = 'GENERAL' --Include Trusted Transactions AND (@Incl_Trusted_Trxn_Fl = 'Y' or COALESCE(B.TRSTD_TRXN_FL,'N') ='N') ) ) SELECT --Employee g.Emp_Intrl_Id, g.Emp_Seq_Id, --Common Account g.Acct_Intrl_Id, --Tot Journal Amt g.Trans_Amt, --Tot Journal Ct g.Trans_Ct, --Offset Acct Ct g.Offset_Acct_Ct, --Empl Acct Ct g.Emp_Acct_Ct, --% Trans w/Trusted Pairs g.Trusted_Trans_Prctg, --Overall Risk g.Overall_Risk, --Effctv Risk Lvl g.Efctv_Risk_Nb, --Actvty Risk Lvl g.Actvy_Risk_Nb, g.Lrf_Prctg, g.Hr_Prctg FROM ( SELECT t.Emp_Intrl_Id, t.Emp_Seq_Id, t.Emp_Hire_Dt, t.Emp_Type, t.Acct_Intrl_Id, CASE WHEN SUM(t.Trxn_Base_Am) > 0 THEN (SUM(t.Lrf_Trxn_Am)/SUM(t.Trxn_Base_Am))*100 ELSE 0 END AS Lrf_Prctg,
CASE WHEN SUM(t.Trxn_Base_Am) > 0 THEN (SUM(t.Hr_Trxn_Am)/SUM(t.Trxn_Base_Am))*100 ELSE 0 END AS Hr_Prctg,
CASE WHEN SUM(t.Trxn_Base_Am) > 0 THEN (SUM(t.Trusted_Trans_Amt)/SUM(t.Trxn_Base_Am))*100 ELSE 0 END AS Trusted_Trans_Prctg,
MAX(t.Efctv_Risk_Nb) as Efctv_Risk_Nb, MAX(t.Actvy_Risk_Nb) as Actvy_Risk_Nb, MAX(t.Data_Dump_Dt) as Data_Dump_Dt, SUM(t.Trxn_Base_Am) as Trans_Amt, COUNT(t.Bo_Trxn_Seq_Id) as Trans_Ct, COUNT(DISTINCT(t.Offst_Acct_Intrl_Id)) as Offset_Acct_Ct, COUNT(DISTINCT(t.Emp_Offst_Acct)) as Emp_Acct_Ct, CASE WHEN MAX(t.Efctv_Risk_Nb) >= @Effctv_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl AND MAX(t.Actvy_Risk_Nb) >= @Actvty_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl THEN 'HR' WHEN MAX(t.Efctv_Risk_Nb) < @Effctv_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl AND MAX(t.Actvy_Risk_Nb) < @Actvty_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl THEN 'RR' ELSE 'MR' END as Overall_Risk
FROM All_Trxn t GROUP BY t.Emp_Intrl_Id, t.Emp_Seq_Id, t.Emp_Hire_Dt, Emp_Type, t.Acct_Intrl_Id ) g WHERE --emp_type = NEW (g.Emp_Type = 'NEW' AND ( (g.Overall_Risk = 'HR' and g.Trans_Amt >= @HR_Min_Total_Journal_Amt_New and g.Trans_Ct >= @HR_Min_Journal_Ct_New) or (g.Overall_Risk = 'RR' and g.Trans_Amt >= @RR_Min_Total_Journal_Amt_New and g.Trans_Ct >= @RR_Min_Journal_Ct_New) or (g.Overall_Risk = 'MR' and g.Trans_Amt >= @MR_Min_Total_Journal_Amt_New and g.Trans_Ct >= @MR_Min_Journal_Ct_New) ) )
OR --emp_type = SEASONED (g.Emp_Type = 'SEASONED' AND ( (g.Overall_Risk = 'HR' and g.Trans_Amt >= @HR_Min_Total_Journal_Amt_Seasoned and g.Trans_Ct >= @HR_Min_Journal_Ct_Seasoned) or (g.Overall_Risk = 'RR' and g.Trans_Amt >= @RR_Min_Total_Journal_Amt_Seasoned and g.Trans_Ct >= @RR_Min_Journal_Ct_Seasoned) or (g.Overall_Risk = 'MR' and g.Trans_Amt >= @MR_Min_Total_Journal_Amt_Seasoned and g.Trans_Ct >= @MR_Min_Journal_Ct_Seasoned) ) )
